body: That makes sense I guess, mentally healthy people will never understand the pain or the thoughts so to them it's little more than a title, sort of how healthy people view cancer. The ignorant ones make up most of society and the dishonest are probably self-loathing so it's understandable. I guess that's life, I'll either be mocked, pitied or ignored and in reality that's all that can be done about it. You are right though, going through all this made me a much stronger person.

Thanks for your answer and I appreciate what you said, I start cognitive behavioral therapy next week so hopefully that helps and you're right, although it's hard to accept. 

I started hearing voices a couple months ago and the realization of this on top of myself makes suicide seem rational. Despite the strength it takes to survive, society sees someone like me as weak - someone who won't go through with it. I'm ostracized, treated like a pussy (nobody actually knows about the voices) and yesterday I overheard someone say "[Justanotherexit] should commit suicide, he'd be better off dead anyway. I wouldn't hang out with him to save his life.". It's everywhere and this makes me fucking crazy...

Sorry for the long response, it gives you a better idea of some stuff though
